title: Land a job at a top 10 tech company of your choice in 2022. Pay only if you get it.
body_markdown:
#### Outtalent applications are now open for Winter 2022!


Hubble Space Telescope revisits the Veil (NASA/ESA)


#### Outtalent


Outtalent is a mentorship program focused on people’s careers and inspired by startup accelerators like[YCombinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/) . We are an online career accelerator designed to help software engineers get jobs at top 10 companies.


We operate under a model called Income Shared Agreement (ISA), in which fellows pay nothing before or while they are in the program. Instead, they only pay if they get a job in a top 10 company of their choice.


#### The program


Our online program for backend and iOS engineers is 4-months long and it's led by engineers and engineering managers from companies like Google, Facebook, and Stripe. The goal is to ramp up knowledge of distributed system design, algorithms, and data structures. During the program, fellows also work on their writing and storytelling skills, which will help with behavioral interviews, and get salary negotiation support.


Our network of alumni, mentors and friends is present across the world’s most well-established and fast-growing tech companies. They trust the program and so are comfortable referring fellows to companies like: Amazon, Apple, Facebook, Google, Microsoft, Airbnb, Atlassian, Bloomberg, Booking.com, Coinbase, Databricks, Flexiport, LinkedIn, Lyft, MongoDB, Netflix, Palantir, Pinterest, Reddit, Snap, Shoppify, Spotify, Square, Stripe, Tesla, TikTok, Twich, Twitter, Uber, Unit, Waymo, Affirm, Asana, DeepMind, Figma, Planet, Slack, Verify, X, the moonshot factory, Adobe, Behavox, Cisco, Cloudfare, Cognite, DoorDash, HBO, IBM, Klarna, NVIDIA, Intuit, Oracle, PayPal, Salesforce, TaskRabbit, Upwork, Wise, and Yelp.


#### Applications are open


We are looking for ambitious engineers who want to land jobs at the world’s top tech companies. To be eligible, they must have 2+ years of full-time work experience or an impressive engineering accomplishment, as well as advanced theoretical knowledge in their domain of expertise (backend or iOS).


Check out what the application process is like:


1. **Eligibility check.** We ask candidates to fill out a simple 2-minute form that will help us understand if Outtalent is the best choice for them.
2. **CodeSignal test.** We assess our candidates' coding skills. It's 4 problems, and candidates should spend around 1 hour on it.
3. **iOS Challenge.** If candidates are applying for the iOS track, we will send them an iOS challenge they need to solve.
4. **Technical interview.** You will be interviewed either by our staff or by an alumni, who will assess your distributed systems design skills.
5. **Co-founder meetings.** We learn more about how candidates think, their values and goals. They ask us questions about the program.
6. **Trial.** We invite candidates for a 2-week trial in which we will see if they can spend the minimum 15 hours/week in program-related tasks.


We make it a point of giving constructive feedback after each stage so candidates know what we expected and also how to improve.


#### Reasons to apply


We are really proud of our results, 100% of our latest batch got jobs at top 10 companies of their choice.


Check out where our 28 alumni landed full-time jobs:


- x8 joined Facebook (London x7 and Menlo Park)
- x6 joined Google (Warsaw x5 and Zurich)
- x2 joined Amazon (Dublin and Vancouver), Microsoft (Prague x2), Snap (London x2), Stripe (Dublin and London), and Palantir (London x2)
- x1 joined DeepMind (London), Flexport (Amsterdam), Spotify (Berlin) and Uber (Amsterdam)


Check out a few reasons why our fellows decide to join us:


1. We help you stay motivated and prepare ~4x faster than you would prepare alone
2. We increase compensation by 20k+ USD on average by synchronizing offers and helping you negotiate well
3. We ensure you get a higher seniority level and avoid downgrades that happen to international candidates
4. We know the depth and the breadth of knowledge you need and help you avoid extra months of preparation
5. We have outstanding mentors from companies you target who give specific, constant feedback


You can read more about the top[15 reasons](https://medium.com/outtalent/5-practical-reasons-why-you-should-use-a-career-accelerator-c272df2f7a5d) for joining Outtalent from our graduates.


#### Apply now


Apply now to secure your spot. Our batches consist of only 8–10 people each, so everyone has the proper attention throughout the program. Seats are limited and first-come, first-served. Fill out the form at[outtalent.com/check](http://outtalent.com/check) to check your eligibility. It should take ˜2 minutes.


**Got a question?** Send your question to[team@outtalent.com](http://team@outtalent.com/) or reach out on our Admissions Telegram chat ([https://t.me/outtalentadmissions](https://t.me/outtalentadmissions) ).
